items.title: ‘Bravest person I know’: Father’s pride as school shooting victim leaves hospital after 262 days
items.brief: A 13-year-old girl who was critically wounded in the deadly February school shooting in Tumbler Ridge, Canada, has been released from hospital after 262 days, her father said Thursday.

items.title: After decades of boycotts, Palestinian citizens of Israel turned out to vote. It could shape what comes next
items.brief: For decades, many Palestinian citizens of Israel stayed away from the polls, refusing to legitimize a system they say has oppressed their people, sidelined their concerns, and failed to represent them.

items.title: Russia strikes Dnipro train station in central Ukraine, killing 15
items.brief: A Russian drone struck the main railway station in the central Ukrainian city of Dnipro as people waited to board a train on Thursday morning, killing 15 people.
